title: QA Scenario Runner admin contract
purpose: Promote frame 02 into a bounded future admin QA scenario dossier.
scope_boundary: Admin-only scenario planning, precondition, step, assertion, and evidence UI; no real browser runner or test automation engine inside the plugin.
entry_condition: TASK-009 snapshot/export is complete and QA evidence patterns from TASK-006 through TASK-008 are available.
exit_condition: QA Scenario Runner tasks and tests are defined with execution runtime deferred.
allowed_expansion: Define scenario cards, precondition rows, step rows, assertion rows, and evidence slots.
Define visual QA requirements based on frame 02.
forbidden_expansion: Build a Playwright runner inside WordPress.
Execute live page visits from the plugin.
Persist test evidence beyond documented admin contract mock state.

budgets.context_budget: frame 02 plus existing QA evidence conventions

tasks: Define scenario scope, preconditions, steps, assertions, evidence, and report pipeline as admin data.
Define pass/fail/degraded visual states without executing tests.
Define visual QA for scenario rows, inspector, and evidence slots.

steps: Read the subplan scope boundary and forbidden expansion list.
